purpose: Document first-party local-government discovery and bounded anonymous cadastral/map-service review for Guarenas, Municipio Ambrosio Plaza, Miranda, Venezuela.
assessment: The official Alcaldía de Guarenas and municipal SIGAT/SATMAP pages establish a local municipal-government and tax-service context. They did not expose a public cadastral parcel viewer or feature API in the reviewed HTML/JavaScript. Historical/currently referenced IGVSB service routes were probed, but no usable anonymous parcel response was obtained. No polygon or native parcel identity was retained.
registryAssessment: A local municipal administrative custodian is evidenced, but a local cadastral registry, map, or public cadastral procedure was not sufficiently evidenced for registryFound=true; the city record therefore uses null.
